topic: MLOps and End-to-End AI Project Architecture
learningObjectives: Understand the lifecycle of a production machine learning system
Identify monitoring, versioning, and retraining components
Design an end-to-end architecture for an AI application

activities.title: MLOps Lifecycle Map
activities.instruction: Explore each stage of the machine learning lifecycle.

content.concept: MLOps connects development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance throughout the ML lifecycle.

activities.title: Production ML Architecture
activities.instruction: Build a production-ready conceptual ML architecture.

content.concept: A production ML system can include data ingestion, feature processing, model serving, monitoring, storage, and retraining.

activities.title: Monitoring the Model
activities.instruction: Select the signals that should be monitored in production.

content.concept: Production monitoring can track service health, prediction behavior, data quality, and model performance.

activities.title: Retraining Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps from monitoring an issue to deploying an updated model.

content.concept: A retraining workflow can collect new data, validate it, train and evaluate an updated model, then deploy it when appropriate.
